class.name: IfcTransportElement
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : Generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a building or building complex. The IfcTransportElement defines the occurrence of a transport element, that (if given), is expressed by the IfcTransportElementType .
